name: mengyin-study
description: MengYin Study — a plugin-driven revision and practice app (web + desktop)

scripts.dev: npm run plugins:sync && npm run runtimes:fetch && npm run dev --workspace @mengyin/web
scripts.build: npm run plugins:sync && npm run runtimes:fetch && npm run build --workspace @mengyin/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @mengyin/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @mengyin/desktop
